scenes.title: From your priorities to a briefing
scenes.caption: Follow the sources through collection, analysis and human review.
scenes.beat: You choose the topics and sources. The daily run collects four items and groups the repeated API notice, leaving three developments. It ranks them against your objective and keeps the failed feed visible. The briefing keeps the evidence attached so you can review the proposed next step.
details: Sources, topic priorities and reporting frequency belong in configuration.
Grouping checks canonical URLs, content fingerprints and event meaning. A repost is not independent evidence.
Each archived briefing retains source excerpts, ranking reasons and missing-source status.

stories.title: Supplier retires its old export API
stories.summary: The primary notice gives a 60-day window. Your actual dependency is still unknown.
stories.why: Data continuity is your highest priority. A dependent export could stop working after retirement.
stories.action: Inventory export jobs for v1 dependencies.
stories.uncertainty: Confirm current API usage, the supplier deadline and replacement compatibility before planning a migration.

evidence.title: Primary supplier notice
evidence.excerpt: Export API v1 will retire in 60 days.

evidence.title: Repeated supplier notice
evidence.excerpt: The supplier says v1 retires in 60 days. This repost refers back to source A.

stories.title: A data-service pilot opens for testing
stories.summary: A limited pilot may fit a current research task. The benefit has not been tested.
stories.why: The pilot could improve one existing research task if its coverage matches your needs.
stories.action: Compare pilot coverage with one research task.
stories.uncertainty: Check eligibility, coverage quality and terms before investing time in a trial.

evidence.title: Limited pilot announcement
evidence.excerpt: Applications are open for a limited data-service pilot.

stories.title: A competitor claim needs a primary source
stories.summary: One market anecdote offers no confirmed launch details. Keep it below the verified updates.
stories.why: A verified competitor launch could affect your plans. This anecdote does not yet establish a launch.
stories.action: Find a primary announcement before changing plans.
stories.uncertainty: The claim may be incomplete or incorrect. Seek an official announcement and product details.

evidence.excerpt: A market comment claims a competitor may be preparing a launch. No announcement is cited.
